clue.text: Stumble at second hearing of panel

parts.note: to stumble is to trip

indicators.note: at its hearing, the word for a moment is taken as spoken, giving a sound-alike spelling

parts.note: a tick is a moment, a second

explanation.surface: Someone trips up when giving evidence a second time before a panel of judges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Panel' looks like a jury or committee; here it is the painted kind. 'at' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-part altarpiece painting is made of hinged panels, so it can be called a panel work.

clue.text: Jane's swinging partner?

parts.note: Jane in the jungle stories is partnered by the ape man who swings on vines

explanation.definitionFit: Edgar Rice Burroughs' jungle hero, mate of Jane Porter, travels by swinging on vines.

clue.text: Bury struggle with questions

parts.note: to inter is to bury
to vie is to compete or struggle

explanation.surface: Burying a struggle by asking questions about it.
explanation.definitionFit: To interrogate a candidate or witness is to put queries to them.

clue.text: Taste for drilling and extraction

definitions.meaning: a liking, as in having a sweet one
a dentist drills or pulls this

explanation.definitionFit: A fondness is called a sweet one, and a dentist drills and extracts this bit of the mouth.

clue.text: Happened to be copied about solo from Star Wars

indicators.note: the copied term wraps round the character's first name

parts.note: cc'd means copied in on an email
Han Solo is a Star Wars character

explanation.surface: Something occurred to be duplicated around a Star Wars hero.
explanation.walkthrough: To cc someone is to copy them in on an email, so 'copied' gives the past tense of that. 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To have come about by luck is to have occurred by accident.

clue.text: An unrefined state of the Caribbean

parts.note: unrefined material is raw
AK is the postal abbreviation for Alaska, a US state

explanation.surface: Describes some crude republic somewhere in the West Indies.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arawak were an indigenous people of the Caribbean islands, so the name serves as an adjective for that region.

clue.text: Beneficiary of up-to-date computer address I stored

indicators.note: the address and I are kept inside the up-to-date word

parts.note: something up-to-date is recent
an IP address identifies a computer on a network

explanation.surface: Someone receives a current network address with I saved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up-to-date' looks like it describes the computer address, but it supplies the outer word.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who receives a gift or benefit is its beneficiary.

clue.text: Where to keep watch on joint

definitions.meaning: the joint between hand and forearm

explanation.definitionFit: A timepiece is strapped on here, and it is the articulation linking hand to arm.

clue.text: Middle East city where Spooner may help a vehicle

indicators.note: the Reverend Spooner famously swapped initial sounds of words

parts.note: to hand is to help out
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: In some Middle Eastern town, an awkward cleric might lend a car.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the opening sounds of HAND and A CAR gives CAND A HAR, the city's name by sound.
explanation.definitionFit: This city lies in southern Afghanistan, loosely placed in the wider Middle East region.

clue.text: It's logical for Capone to supplement share

indicators.note: Capone's first name is placed after the share as an addition to it

parts.note: a ration is a fixed share or allowance
Al Capone, the Chicago gangster

explanation.surface: Asks whether it makes sense for a gangster to top up his cut of the takings.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rational follows reason, which is synonymous with logical.

clue.text: Follows camera in studio suit

definitions.meaning: a film director calls 'Lights, camera...' and then this word
a lawsuit is a legal case brought in court

explanation.definitionFit: The director's cry comes after 'camera', and a lawsuit is a legal proceeding of this name.

clue.text: Prepare to make a circuit with injury to chest and waist

indicators.note: injury to the two body parts signals that their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Getting ready for a training circuit after hurting the torso and middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Configuring a toggle so current will flow readies an electrical loop to complete.

clue.text: Hagar's despairing cry

indicators.note: a despairing state throws the name into disorder, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: The sound Hagar makes when she gives up hope.
explanation.walkthrough: Hagar is a biblical figure (and a comic-strip Viking); her name's letters are shuffled by 'despairing'.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of frustration or anguish is a classic cry of despair.

clue.text: Ruler repeatedly needled by chisellers

definitions.meaning: an Egyptian queen who reigned over the Ptolemaic kingdom
several carved stone obelisks in London, New York and Paris bear her name as 'Needles'

explanation.definitionFit: She was the last Ptolemaic queen of Egypt, and the obelisks called her Needles were chiselled by stonemasons.

clue.text: Sound of film came too late

indicators.note: the word for a thin haze is said out loud to give a different spelling

parts.note: a thin film of moisture is a mist

explanation.surface: A soundtrack for a movie arrived after the deadline.
explanation.definitionFit: If you arrive too late for a train or meeting you failed to catch it.

clue.text: Test, part English, in device of ruler

indicators.note: the cricket term and E are placed inside the emblem

parts.note: a heraldic device is a sign or emblem
an over is a part of a cricket Test match, six balls bowled

explanation.surface: A monarch's emblem includes an English section of a Test match.
explanation.walkthrough: A Test is an international cricket match; an over is a set of six deliveries in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch is a supreme ruler.

clue.text: States a degree of limitation for boy

indicators.note: the degree sets bounds around the boy, enclosing him

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts degree
Eric is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A qualification restricting what a lad may do.
explanation.definitionFit: The United States are commonly referred to by the continent's name.

clue.text: Useless rain-cap a blemish exposed

indicators.note: exposed means the run of letters is laid bare within these words

explanation.surface: A rain hat shown to have a flaw is no good.
explanation.definitionFit: Unable to do anything effectively means ineffectual or of no use.

clue.text: Treats with element of additional raise Ben's after

indicators.note: in a down clue raise means the word is lifted upwards, read bottom to top

parts.note: plus means additional
after Ben in the film title Ben-Hur comes Hur, and the 's adds S

explanation.surface: Treating a pay rise that Ben is chasing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raise' reverses PLUS to SULP in this down clue; Ben-Hur is the epic film. 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Dusting crops or vines with brimstone is to fumigate them with that chemical substance.

clue.text: Posh area of Manchester range taken apart

parts.note: U means upper-class, posh, in crossword convention
Manchester lies in England's North West, NW
a range is a cooking stove with an oven

explanation.surface: A smart district of Manchester has had its kitchen stove dismantled.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric that has been unpicked thread by thread has been dismantled or undone.

clue.text: See 25
Persuade rebellious niece to swallow tablet, finally

indicators.note: the rearranged relative takes in the letter as if gulping a pill
a rebellious niece is unruly, so her letters are rearranged
the last letter of tablet is taken

explanation.surface: Coax an unruly young relative into taking her pill at last.
explanation.definitionFit: To tempt or lure someone is to persuade them to act.

clue.text: Nothing relieves a general disaster soon

indicators.note: a disaster suggests the letters are thrown into confusion
relieves means takes the place of, as one sentry relieves another

parts.note: O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A general's catastrophe is coming shortly, and nothing will ease it.
explanation.walkthrough: O replaces the A in GENERAL, giving GENEROL, which 'disaster' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic way of saying before long or shortly.

clue.text: See 11
Long to hold damaged lower cable

indicators.note: the longing word surrounds the rearranged letters

parts.note: to long for is to pine

indicators.note: damaged suggests the letters of lower are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: Someone yearns to keep a broken cable that sags too low.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long' reads as an adjective for the cable but is the verb meaning to yearn.
explanation.definitionFit: An overhead electricity conductor is a cable carrying current.

clue.text: Doctor both hands in turn

parts.note: Doctor Who is the TV time-lord
R and L stand for right and left hands

explanation.surface: A medic uses both hands one after another.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiral or coil, such as on a shell or fingerprint, is a turn.

clue.text: Give secretary a hand with fruit

parts.note: PA is a personal assistant, a secretary
a paw is a hand, informally

explanation.surface: An instruction to help out one's secretary with some fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The papaya or the North American pawpaw is a tropical fruit, known by this spelling too.

clue.text: Variety of hazy premonition excludes me

indicators.note: a hazy premonition is blurred, so its letters are jumbled
excludes means the letters of me are left out

explanation.surface: A vague hunch keeps the speaker out of it.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove M and E from PREMONITION; 'hazy' rearranges the remaining PRONITION.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a black grape cultivar, a type of wine grape grown in Burgundy.

clue.text: More island retsinas lost from faulty pasteurisation

indicators.note: the letters of the Greek wine are taken out of the longer word
faulty signals that the remaining letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Greek wine bottles went missing because the heat treatment was faulty.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the letters of RETSINAS from PASTEURISATION and the six left, P A U T I O, are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas More's 1516 book describes an imaginary ideal island state of this name.

clue.text: It's likely to pay bad debt on us

indicators.note: a bad state of affairs signals that the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A bad debt has been landed on us.
explanation.definitionFit: A wager with good chances of winning is a safe and reliable gamble.

clue.text: Tying up loose ends isn't dumb

indicators.note: tying things up tangles them together, so these letters are mixed
the ends of the word loose are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Advice that wrapping up remaining matters is not foolish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ends' takes L and E from 'loose'; 'Tying up' mixes them with ISNT to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Dumb in its older sense means unable or unwilling to speak, hence without sound.

clue.text: Cutting edge tools for fledgling escapologist

definitions.text: Cutting edge tools for fledgling escapologist

parts.words: Cutting edge tools for fledgling escapologist
parts.note: a hatching chick breaks out of its shell using a small sharp tip on its beak

explanation.definitionFit: Newly hatching birds and reptiles use a tiny horny point on the beak to cut the shell open.
